name: Shiokoi
source:
──It's a casual turning point in everyday life──...

The main character is an ordinary high school boy who can be found anywhere.

One day after school, it was supposed to be the same as usual, but.... A small fork in the road will greatly change the main character's future....

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/7632]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
——那只是日常生活中一个不经意的转折……

主角是一名随处可见的普通高中男生。

某天放学后，一切本应一如往常，然而……一个小小的岔路口，将彻底改变主角的未来……

[译自 [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/7632]NovelGame[/url]]
